metadata.description: Curated skills for Claude Code: deep research, code simplification, and dev-loop cycles; codebase-architecture analysis/extract chain.

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Source-triaged research engine with local-first evidence, grok-search freshness checks, Context7 verification, tiered model pinning, deep-fetch, content refinement, and vault integration. Spawnable as a subagent (model: sonnet) via deep-research:deep-research.

plugins.name: deep-research-dev
plugins.description: Experimental prerelease dev-lane fork of deep-research (base 2.4.3) for controlled evaluation: source-triaged research with local-first evidence, grok-search freshness checks, Context7 verification, tiered model pinning, deep-fetch, refinement, and vault integration. Not for production use.

plugins.name: simplify
plugins.description: Code review for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude

plugins.name: dev-loop
plugins.description: Adaptive dev cycle engine with SkillWiki vault, preflight prep, investigate, office-hours, config-lint, and cross-harness verification. Pass `high` for aggressive mode.

plugins.name: agent-plugin-porter
plugins.description: Guide for using agent-plugin-porter to convert Claude Code plugins into Codex and Agy/Gemini packages, verify generated output, install Codex personal-marketplace packages, and prepare npm publish/release workflow checks.

plugins.name: claude-md-management
plugins.description: Tools to maintain and improve CLAUDE.md files - audit quality, capture session learnings, and keep project memory current.

plugins.name: hermes-cli
plugins.description: Hermes Agent CLI commands reference — full terminal command surface for hermes-agent by NousResearch

plugins.name: playwright-cli
plugins.description: Playwright CLI setup and browser automation with a user-level chrome-debug command, project config initialization, attach-first global Chrome default-user profile, browser-worker, and Linux/LXC support

plugins.name: rtk-output-design
plugins.description: RTK-inspired output contract for building token-efficient CLI, skill, hook, and script developer tools.

plugins.name: host-backup-restore
plugins.description: Host-level backup and restore with profile system, model-aware sonnet workers, post-discovery research, skillwiki infrastructure capture, and Hermes module. Supports Caddy domains, databases, systemd services, and Hermes snapshots.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Relentless plan/design interview skills adapted from Matt Pocock's grilling, with inline cross-platform question style.

plugins.name: codebase-architecture
plugins.description: Codebase analysis and reimplementation skill chain: router, deep-module design vocabulary, architecture analyze/extract, deepening HTML/MD reviews, and architecture-to-spec PRDs.

plugins.name: grok-resume
plugins.description: Source-faithful Grok Build resume-codex and resume-claude skills with the complete inert session reader, raw source snapshots, and cross-platform wrapper compatibility.

plugins.name: grok-build-harness
plugins.description: Fresh-host bootstrap for the karlorz subagent harness — installs custom agents, agentrules, BYOK config, and the companion plugin set. Idempotent, backup-first, GROK_HOME-aware.

plugins.name: grok-search
plugins.description: Thin marketplace plugin for GrokSearch: live web search, structured intent planning, source extraction, URL fetching, and site mapping via HTTP MCP.

plugins.name: cursor-box-channel
plugins.description: Thin marketplace plugin for cursor-box-channel: stdio MCP interface to the local cursor-box macOS daemon bridge for cross-agent channel communication.
